verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to build a reusable sub-workflow or user-authored module that other workflows call. It mentions pre-built triggers and actions, inline custom code steps, deploying event sources via the CLI, and contributing components to the public registry by PR. These are adjacent features, not documented workflow-to-workflow composition, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
